text:
Carol likely wins. The ad's description of a 1964 Thunderbird, with the website picture, created an express warranty about the car's year, and the "as is" clause disclaims only implied warranties, not express ones. The team note is wrong on one point: express warranty liability is strict and doesn't require proof that the seller was careless, so Carol needs only to show the car didn't match the description.

CONFIDENCE: 82
